exam.title: Microsoft 365 Administrator
exam.study_prerequisites: Functional experience across Microsoft 365 workloads and Microsoft Entra ID plus working knowledge of networking, AD DS, DNS and PowerShell; hands-on tenant, hybrid identity, Defender XDR, Defender for Office 365, Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Cloud Apps, Purview and Conditional Access administration is strongly recommended.

objective_coverage.objective_group: Deploy and manage a Microsoft 365 tenant
Implement and manage Microsoft Entra identity and access
Manage security and threats by using Microsoft Defender XDR

review.notes: Every April 28, 2026 objective is mapped to a tenant, identity, security, compliance, operating, evidence, failure, or recovery decision. Three integrated scenarios, eight independent labs, and 36 original checks cover tenant operations, Entra hybrid identity and access, Defender XDR, and Purview. All 61 cited URLs are cataloged: 58 reachable and three commercial pages access-blocked. The September 7 watch adds current Entra, Defender, Purview, and Copilot feeds plus the Entra Connect enforcement boundary while keeping the November 30, 2026 retirement and retiring blueprint controlling.

findings.title: Two different enforcement failures
findings.evidence: Connect Sync and Health have different minimum versions and effects.
findings.recommendation: Separate version inventory and failure interpretation.
findings.resolution: Separate version inventory and failure interpretation.

findings.title: Minimum is not current support
findings.evidence: 2.6.92 fixes PTA registration; 2.5.79 support ends October 23.
findings.recommendation: Add support/current-release distinction and scheduled recheck.
findings.resolution: Add support/current-release distinction and scheduled recheck.

findings.title: Certificate ownership and scheduler matter
findings.evidence: Managed, BYOC and BYOA assign different lifecycle duties; suspended scheduler stops managed rotation.
findings.recommendation: Add identity/credential evidence and new versus existing configuration distinction.
findings.resolution: Add identity/credential evidence and new versus existing configuration distinction.

findings.title: Nested membership is not entitlement
findings.evidence: Only direct users inherit; migration must await destination assignment.

findings.title: Frozen membership can preserve stale access
findings.recommendation: Map downstream dependencies, migration and validation.
findings.resolution: Map downstream dependencies, migration and validation.

findings.title: Shorter recovery windows delete older history
findings.evidence: Four window choices; reduction or move to shorter policy triggers 30-day grace.
findings.recommendation: Explain active-policy state, consequences and inability to recreate expired points.
findings.resolution: Explain active-policy state, consequences and inability to recreate expired points.

findings.title: Second-year recovery-point cadence undocumented
findings.evidence: Policy supports two years but frequency table covers only days 0–365.
findings.recommendation: Keep the support limitation visible pending authoritative evidence.

findings.title: Granular recovery has a different schedule
findings.evidence: Granular points roughly daily versus full-site ten-minute first fortnight; in-place destination permissions apply.
findings.recommendation: Add operation-specific RPO/RTO exercise and permission checks.
findings.resolution: Add operation-specific RPO/RTO exercise and permission checks.

findings.title: Paused custom policy keeps precedence
findings.evidence: Full Workload Backup preview does not override paused custom coverage; scans new items daily.
findings.recommendation: Add precedence, exclusions and static/dynamic selection boundaries.
findings.resolution: Add precedence, exclusions and static/dynamic selection boundaries.

findings.title: Current restore supersedes historical roadmap
findings.evidence: Detailed restore/current feed support granular in-place behavior despite older overview/blog.
findings.recommendation: Qualify historical blog wording without extrapolating second-year cadence.
findings.resolution: Qualify historical blog wording without extrapolating second-year cadence.

findings.title: Policy composition requires distinct reasoning
findings.evidence: OR within a policy does not become OR across policies.

findings.title: Legacy grant is read-only
findings.evidence: Enabled legacy policies continue enforcing after June 30.
findings.recommendation: Explain tested new-policy migration and old-policy behavior.
findings.resolution: Explain tested new-policy migration and old-policy behavior.

findings.title: Email policies do not merge settings
findings.evidence: Strict and Standard precede custom matching policy of same type.
findings.recommendation: Add worked priority example distinct from CA.
findings.resolution: Add worked priority example distinct from CA.

findings.title: Tagging needs an enforcement path
findings.evidence: Unsanctioned state alone is not evidence of a blocked request.

findings.title: Explorer access is more than portal access
findings.evidence: List and Content viewer are separate and content access can override item permissions.
findings.recommendation: Add current naming and least-privilege evidence boundary.
findings.resolution: Add current naming and least-privilege evidence boundary.

findings.title: External-chat policy does not follow every user
findings.evidence: Hosting-tenant own-user protection and message/file scopes differ.
findings.recommendation: Add tenant-specific test matrix and DLP precision/recall example.
findings.resolution: Add tenant-specific test matrix and DLP precision/recall example.

findings.title: Retirement cohorts have exceptions
findings.evidence: Global Administrators and external users are July; internal guests remain February.
findings.recommendation: Add explicit cohorts and shared-guide follow-up.
findings.resolution: Add explicit cohorts and shared-guide follow-up.

findings.title: Course replacement is not a credential promise
findings.evidence: MS-102T00 row lists AB-650T00; credential still requires one of four associates.
findings.recommendation: Separate training, exam and expert certification lifecycle.
findings.resolution: Separate training, exam and expert certification lifecycle.
